items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the right exactness of the localisation sequence of Chow groups at source lines 1950-1968, label lemma-restrict-to-open, whose proof occupies source lines 1970-1988. The proof does not merely quote exactness: it lifts a rational equivalence from the open subspace to the ambient space by replacing each component on the open by the integral closed subspace with the same generic point, and it has to verify that the lifted family is still locally finite, which is done by testing against quasi-compact opens and using that the intersections transfer. Since the rational function fields are unchanged, the difference of the original cycles and the sum of the pushed forward divisors restricts to zero on the open, and the exactness statement for the closed complement then produces the required cycle. The counted statement records neither the lifting nor the local finiteness check.
